fields.climate: temperate; mild winters and cool summers
fields.terrain: gently rolling plain with low, rugged hills along north coast
fields.hazards: very large tidal variation can be hazardous to navigation
fields.farm: potatoes, cauliflower, tomatoes; beef, dairy products
fields.exports: refined petroleum, beverages, ships, jewelry, artwork
fields.industries: tourism, banking and finance, dairy, electronics
fields.languages: English (official) 94.5%, Portuguese 4.6%, other 0.9% (includes French (official) and Jerriais)
fields.religions: Christian 85.2%, Baha'i 0.3%, Hindu 0.1%, Jewish 0.1%, Muslim 0.1%, atheist 1.1%, agnostic 13.1%

system.text: parliamentary democracy (Assembly of the States of Jersey)

fields.legal: the laws of the UK apply, as well as local statutes
